[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Return windows

- **Unopened products:** you can return them within **30 days** of delivery for a full refund.
- **Opened products in perfect condition:** you can return them within **14 days** of delivery. The product must include all original accessories, manuals and packaging.
- **Defective products:** if a product stops working within the first **30 days**, we replace it or refund it in full, whether it was opened or not. After 30 days, defects are handled under the warranty policy.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Exchanges

You can exchange a product for a different model or colour within the same return window. If the new product costs more, you pay the difference; if it costs less, we refund the difference.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > How to start a return

1. Open **My Orders** in your account and select the order.
2. Choose **Request Return**, pick the items and the reason.
3. Our team reviews the request within **2 business days**.
4. Once approved, a courier collects the item from your address for free (Cairo and Giza) or you can drop it at any ShopMind branch.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy

At ShopMind Electronics we want you to be happy with every purchase. This policy explains when and how you can return a product and how refunds are paid.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Products that cannot be returned

- Items sold in the **Clearance** section are final sale and cannot be returned unless they are defective.
- Opened software, gift cards, and digital licence codes.
- In-ear headphones and earbuds once the hygiene seal is broken, unless they are defective.
- Products damaged by misuse, liquid, drops, or unauthorised repair.

[POL-001] Return and Refund Policy
Return and Refund Policy > Refunds

- Refunds go back to the **original payment method**.
- Card payments: **5 to 10 business days** after we receive and inspect the item.
- Cash on delivery orders: refunded to a ShopMind wallet within **2 business days**, or by bank transfer within **7 business days** if you request it.
- Shipping fees are refunded only when the return is due to our error or a defective product.

d1.answer:
You have **14 days** from the date of delivery to return an opened product, provided it is in perfect condition and includes all original accessories, manuals, and packaging [POL-001]. 

If the product is defective, you have up to **30 days** from delivery to request a full refund or replacement [POL-001]. 

*Note: Certain items, such as clearance products or opened in-ear headphones with broken hygiene seals, are final sale and cannot be returned unless defective [POL-001].*

tool_results.content:
[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > Warranty length

- Every product sold by ShopMind has an official warranty. The warranty length is written on each product page and on the invoice.
- Phones, laptops, tablets and TVs: usually **12 to 24 months** of manufacturer warranty.
- Accessories (chargers, cables, cases): **6 months** of ShopMind warranty.
- Products in the Clearance section keep their manufacturer warranty, but ShopMind's extra warranty does not apply.

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > ShopMind Care+ (extended warranty)

You can add **ShopMind Care+** at checkout to extend the warranty by **12 months** and add one accidental damage repair (screen or liquid). Care+ costs **8% of the product price** and must be bought with the product or within 7 days of delivery.

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > What the warranty covers

Manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship under normal use: for example a phone that does not charge, a laptop with a dead keyboard, or headphones with one silent side.

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > What the warranty does not cover

- Physical damage: cracked screens, dents, bent ports.
- Liquid damage, even on water-resistant devices.
- Battery wear after 12 months (battery capacity naturally drops over time).
- Software problems caused by unofficial software, rooting or jailbreaking.
- Damage from repairs done outside an authorised service centre.

[POL-003] Warranty Policy
Warranty Policy > How to make a warranty claim

1. Keep your invoice; you can download it any time from **My Orders**.
2. Request a warranty service from the order page or visit any ShopMind branch.
3. We inspect the device within **3 business days** and send it to the authorised service centre if needed.
4. Typical repair time is **7 to 14 business days**. If the same defect happens **three times**, we replace the device.

d4.answer:
The warranty does not cover the following [POL-003]:

*   **Physical damage:** such as cracked screens, dents, or bent ports.
*   **Liquid damage:** this applies even to water-resistant devices.
*   **Battery wear:** specifically after 12 months, as capacity naturally decreases over time.
*   **Software issues:** caused by unofficial software, rooting, or jailbreaking.
*   **Unauthorized repairs:** any damage resulting from repairs performed outside of an authorized service center.
